_about: FM1-Chord factory content: the one source for the firmware (tools/gen_presets.py makes fc_presets.h) and the editor. Chords are written as the editor shows them: root and quality, then optional /BASS, i1..i3 (inversion), open | drop2 | drop3 | spread (voicing) and +1 / -1 / +2 / -2 (the chord's octave). '-' is an empty key. Keys run F3 F#3 G3 ... G5 (27).
